name: F&F Co., Ltd
summary: F&F Co., Ltd., a South Korean firm established in 1972 and based in Seoul, specializes in the production and sale of various sewn clothing items. The company distributes its merchandise under prominent brand names such as MLB, MLB KIDS, DISCOVERY, and DISCOVERY KIDS. As of May 21, 2021, F&F Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A383220) functions autonomously, separate from F&F Holdings Co., Ltd.
